notes.content:

notes.title: Feature Update: Trinket Forge
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26357994/6e52547ee2a94d2a6314326eef1556990d5a42c7.png[/img]

Is it mushroom season already? With the evil Shrooms popping up all over the place once again, we have prepared a new feature to ease your fight—[b]Trinket Forge[/b], as well as a few other things. Let’s dive in!

Are you tired of carrying around all your Trinkets? With the new MCE Trinket Forge, you can merge and upgrade your Plain trinkets, to pack more power into your loadout. You can combine the best of two different Trinkets into one or boost up a single Trinket’s stats. For extra fun, you can switch up your Trinkets’ shapes, colors and names. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26357994/abf4b84fc8272fe53746aa7ff40de0588a83651e.png[/img]

For good measure, we have thrown in [b]a whole new Unique Trinket[/b]—Treasure of the Earth. When equipped, it allows you to summon the powers of Earth itself and relocate level tiles for your convenience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26357994/66e27cbd4a27bf47cb8894e3bc533a61640f74b8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26357994/312bb19f6735828f3fc6e97427b616cc18fdbce8.gif[/img]

See the full notes on the update in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/498000/discussions/1/343787283745664111/]dedicated Steam forum thread[/url].

As much as we’ve enjoyed working on MCE, after nine years, it is time we move on to pastures new. As the game has finally fulfilled our vision of it, this may be the final update we make. Even so, we welcome all new players to join and achieve new heights in Shroom crushing! 

Last but not the least, for the upcoming weekend [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/498000/Mushroom_Crusher_Extreme/]Mushroom Crusher Extreme is 90% off on Steam[/url]. If you don’t already own a copy or just have a friend you’d like to crush some Shrooms with in multiplayer—don’t miss this chance!

 [b]We’ll also be running a competition on Discord community tomorrow[/b]—the winner gets two free copies of MCE and some other goodies. Drop on by to see more details: https://discord.gg/teamjollyroger.

Have fun Trinket forging and keep on crushin’!

notes.title: Mushroom Crusher Extreme 1.0 Released on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26357994/97d087328bd4c2245819b894f58af0c0aff2066a.jpg[/img]

They’re here! The Shrooms are everywhere! Who will rise to the challenge of crushing them all?
If you dare, today’s the day—MCE 1.0 is finally released on Steam.

In case you missed our previous announcement, here’s a list of new things in the 1.0.

[*]9 new levels
[*]10 new Trinkets

[*]Redone game menus
[*]New game options

As is the usual way with Early Access games, you get the full version for free if you bought the game during the Early Access run—just let the game update and enjoy the renewed Mushroom Crusher! After the discount is over, the game will be available for the regular price of $7.99/€7.99.

Lastly, we’re about to have a live stream of MCE 1.0 on our Steam page for the next few hours. Come watch us play and ask us anything in the stream chat.

Keep on crushin’!

notes.title: Mushroom Crusher Extreme 1.0 Coming on May 10th!
notes.content:
Mushroom season is early this year! We’re excited to announce that Mushroom Crusher Extreme is ready to graduate from Early Access into the full release. MCE 1.0 is coming to Steam this Saturday,[b] May 10th, at 6pm PDT[/b]. Watch our new trailer below.
https://youtu.be/wstVEO8FOBM 
It’s been awhile since we last updated the Early Access version of the game and you’re probably wondering what we’ve been up to. We’re hoping that the wait will be worth it, when you see all the new things we’ve added to MCE. We have new levels and Trinkets, new music and a whole lot of smaller neat additions and fixes. See the full list below.

[*]10 new Trinkets
[*]3 new songs in the soundtrack
[*]New Accomplishments (New reward type: Premade Plain Trinkets)
[*]New Dictionary entries
[*]Redone game menus
[*]New game options
[*]Balance & other changes and improvements

If you bought MCE during our Early Access run, the full version of the game will be available to you automatically—just make sure the game is updated in your Steam library on May 10th, at 6pm PDT. Hey, folks! Today we launched MCE 0.97.0, which includes a whole new category of Trinkets - Plain Trinkets.

Aside from those, we added new stats to the Unique Trinkets (a.k.a the old-style Trinkets), some new level visuals and quick-equip function for Spells and Trinkets.

Take a look at [url=http://mushroomcrusher.tumblr.com/post/159525222867/early-access-diaries-8-plain-trinkets]our devblog[/url] for more details on this update.
Also, last week, we published a [url=http://mushroomcrusher.tumblr.com/post/159300947157/crusher-chronicles-9-plain-trinkets]hefty blog post[/url], explaining Plain Trinkets in detail.


[h1]MCE Version 0.97.0 - April 13th, 2017[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Features:[/b]
[list]

Ho-ho-howdy, everyone! Winter holidays are almost here, and it means people getting together. And, in the Shroom world, you don’t need to be close to get together anymore, as we’ve just launched Online Co-op mode!

Here's our co-op teaser video:

http://youtu.be/fW7Nq1sRTN8 

In addition to that we’ve also fixed some bugs, made some balance adjustments and (here comes the dessert!) added some special Holiday visuals. Winter Wonderland is in Pratumea (or, at least, some of its parts), enjoy!

You can find more details about the update in our [url=http://mushroomcrusher.tumblr.com/post/154722333867/early-access-diaries-5-online-co-op]devblog[/url]. The full MCE changelog can be found in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/498000/discussions/1/343787283745664111/]dedicated forum thread[/url].

Enjoy the update and Happy Holidays!

[h1]MCE Version 0.95.0 - December 20th, 2016[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Online Co-Op
[list]
[*]Starting Online Co-op
[list]
[*]You can start the Online Co-op mode in Main Menu by pressing on the button in the top left corner of the screen and selecting “Online Co-op”
[*] You can play in Public mode, where the game will find another player for you by random, or use Friends mode to play with your Steam friends
[*]Selecting the region closest to yours for minimal possible lag. In Public mode you can only join people in the same region. In Friends mode, the region is decided by whoever hosts the game.
[*]Players can chat to each other with the TAB key both in menus and in-game
[*]You can view other players’ equipment from the Equipment Menu
[/list]
[/list]
[*]Host Player
[list]
[*]In Online mode, one player will act as a host. In Public matchmaking it will usually be the player who started searching first.
[*]In case players have same Spells and Trinkets equipped when joining in Online Co-op, host’s equipment will take priority over the other player.
[*]Only the host can change the level, but both players have to agree to play it by pressing Ready.
[*]Other player can suggest a level to the host by pressing on it in the Level Select menu.
[*]Host cannot select a level that hasn't been unlocked by the other player.
[/list]
[*]Accomplishments
[list]
[*]When in Accomplishment menu, clicking on Accomplishments you have completed lets the other player know of your greatness.
[*]Clicking on Accomplishments you haven't completed lets the other player know that you'd like to attempt completing them.
[*]In Online Co-op, Accomplishments progress differently compared to Local Co-Op.
[list]
[*]Most Accomplishments are counted individually for each player
[*]For example: When you defeat an enemy with LV1 Fireball, only you will progress towards the 'We BURN!' Accomplishment
[*]Some Accomplishments still require cooperation from both players, for example, beating a level with Fire spells only requires that BOTH players only equip Fire pells.
[/list]
[/list]
[*]Loot in Online Co-op
[list]
[*]Both players have their own private loot dropped on the ground, not visible for the other player. Health Extracts are the only exception
[*]Collected Spores and Trinkets are not shared!
[*]Enemies defeated by both players can drop Spores and Trinkets.
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[*][b]Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated several dictionary entries
[*]Adjusted all boss Spore drops
[*]Lowered Frozen Lagoon's difficulty a little bit
[*]Lowered some spell cooldowns & damages
[*]Some slight Trinket balancing
[*]Special Holiday visuals added to the game
[/list]
[*][b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Every stacked pick-up now counts towards the Hoarder Accomplishment
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Mushroom Crusher Extreme Update 0.90.0
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26357994/c0c5fb8948013ab35e4ed3597245a87ed986e72d.png[/img]
Hello-hello-hello! It’s our third feature update and it’s a big one—local co-op mode! So, grab yourself a friend and get crushing. 

Watch the teaser trailer here: https://youtu.be/8HXCSdqAXqQ

We’ve also added a few new entries to the game Dictionary and some minor graphical adjustments, fixed some bugs affecting enemy and Spell performance and more.

You can check out the full MCE changelog in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/498000/discussions/1/343787283745664111/]dedicated forum thread[/url]. More details about today’s update can be found in our [url=http://mushroomcrusher.tumblr.com/post/153300901392/early-access-diaries-4-team-up-for-co-op]devbog[/url].

If you want to see Mushroom Party joining forces to fight the wicked Shrooms, today we’re streaming MCE live on to show off the new and shiny local co-op. Join us at 4pm UTC/8am PST [url=https://www.twitch.tv/teamjollyroger]on Twitch[/url]!

[h1]MCE Version 0.90.0 - November 17th, 2016[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Local Co-op
[list]
[*]By pressing the button on top-left of the main menu, you can open a menu to set up Co-op mode
[*]You can turn Co-op on or off from this menu and change control settings for both players
[/list]
[*]A couple of new Dictionary entries + updated a few existing ones
[*]The rest of the level select icons
[/list]
[*][b]Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*]Nerfed Mad Squirrels' roll speed in later levels
[*]Updated many Trinkets' specials' descriptions to better indicate whom their effects apply to
[*]Made poison gas vents a bit darker to make them more visible
[*]Moved a rock in Secluded Den
[*]Small performance optimizations
[*]Switched the places of 2 later Accomplishment rewards
[*]Adjusted Enemy Defeating Accomplishments' enemy amounts required and their Spore rewards
[*]Made Level Rank Accomplishments' Spore rewards more unified
[*]Nerfed Trinket #45
[/list]
[*][b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an error where using Aqua Sphere over ice tiles caused all spells to freeze
[*]Dizzy status no longer makes Palshrooms unable to shoot
[*]Palshrooms and Devs can no longer use their spells or abilities when frozen or stunned
[*]Various Trinket fixes
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Mushroom Crusher Extreme Update 0.82.0
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26357994/f7d93e04ec47d402d793e734c56577751692e4ff.png[/img]
Hi, everyone! The second MCE feature update is out, introducing enemy AI aggro icons. We've also added a few adjustments to the Level selection menu and some Spells and enemies functioning, as well as some bug fixes.

You can check our full changelog to date in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/498000/discussions/1/343787283745664111/]appropriate forum thread[/url]. For more details about today's update, you can visit our [url=http://mushroomcrusher.tumblr.com/post/152684613902/early-access-diaries-3-pop-up-until-you-drop-up]devblog[/url].

[h1]MCE Version 0.82.0 - November 3rd, 2016[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Enemy AI Reaction Icons - enemies now show indicators when noticing Zenon or losing him out of sight
[/list]
[*][b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*]Accomplishment pop-up windows now open full screen and show more info on the unlocked Accomplishment
[*]Spike Crush waves now can “climb stairs”
[*]Charmed enemies now make bonus time when defeating other enemies

[*]When navigating level selection list with keyboard or gamepad, the player is automatically taken to their currently selected level

[*][b]Fixes[/b]

[*]Shader, causing fading objects to flash opaque black, fixed
[*]Charm fixes

[*]Charmed Strishrooms can now damage other enemies
[/list]
[*]Fixed Silence status effect not properly silencing Quadshooms and Palshrooms
[*]Nucshrooms no longer drawn under poison vents
[*]Palshroom fixes
[list]
[*]Palshrooms no longer shoot projectiles sideways
[*]Palshrooms won't try to shoot at player if he is unreachable
[/list]
[*]Quadshroom fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where Quadshrooms were unable to spawn Mycelium
[*]Quadshrooms clouds can no longer get stuck
[/list]
[*]Various trinket fixes
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Mushroom Crusher Extreme Update 0.81.0
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26357994/d63121924aebf0cf237b05cb080cc1b5144d7059.png[/img]
Near Halloween-y greetings, everyone! Now's the time for our first actual feature update, bringing with it a couple of interesting additions plus the usual fixes and adjustments. The heroes of this update are the added mouse controls; a Dictionary for in-game terms, hints and lore; and the Music Room for listening to the auditive joy the game has to offer.

You can go check out the full [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/498000/discussions/1/343787283745664111/]changelog[/url] so far at the appropriate forum thread. For more detailed info and development news, [url=http://mushroomcrusher.tumblr.com/post/152066970862/early-access-diaries-2-boo-its-a-feature]visit our devblog[/url].

[h1]MCE Version 0.81.0 - October 20th, 2016[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Mouse Controls
[list]
[*]Spells can be aimed with mouse cursor, cast with keyboard
[*]Movement possible by holding down left mouse button
[*]Right mouse button works as a TURN key. It is needed for a certain trinket.
[/list]
[*]Extras Menu
[list]
[*]Dictionary - a database of in-game terms
[*]Music Room - a collection of the in-game music. ( BONUS: the song you leave playing is saved as main menu theme)
[/list]
[*]A Secret Halloween Mode
[/list]
[*][b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*]Equipment Menu: changed item list size
[*]Holding down movement keys in menus now auto-scrolls through the menu elements
[*]In game HUD tweaks
[list]
[*]Health Bar, Score, Time and Combo displays made smaller
[/list]
[*]Minor end-game level score balancing
[/list]
[*][b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Inputs fixed
[list]
[*]Cast keys now function as Accept and Cancel menu keys, as stated in Key Binds menu
[/list]
[*]Old Trinkets are no longer highlighted as new
[*]Nucshrooms slime glow fixed in dark levels
[*]Fixed a bug where on low frame rates Strishrooms couldn't hit the player
[*]Fixed a bug where Dizzy status had no effect on player
[*]Various Trinket fixes
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Mushroom Crusher Extreme Patch 0.80.4
notes.content:
Hello, crushers! We've put out a couple of small patches during this first week on Steam. Just fixes and adjustments, with the first actual feature update coming in next Thursday, October 20th. 

You can keep tabs on the whole changelog on our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/498000/discussions/1/343787283745664111/]changelog thread[/url]. We also wrote [url=http://mushroomcrusher.tumblr.com/post/151748661107/early-access-diaries-1-our-first-week]a short blog post about some happenings since the release[/url].

[h1]MCE Version 0.80.4 - October 13th, 2016[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*]"Up Direction" setting in the Control Options menu is now called "Movement"
[*]Movement" setting has 3 options:
[list]
[*]Mode A: Move northeast by pressing up movement key
[*]Mode B: Move northwest by pressing up movement key
[*]Mode C: You have to press movement keys diagonally to move. (This option is recommended for controllers only)
[/list]
[*]Adjusted Trinket drop chances (mostly increased by roughly 10%)
[*]Adjusted accomplishment visibility requirements
[*]Made it slightly easier to upgrade level 1 spells to level 2 (accomplishments now require 35 enemies to be defeated instead of 40)
[*]Replaced a Strishroom in Terror's Return with a Dermshroom to make the level a tad easier
[*]Lowered a couple of spell cooldowns
[*]Small Level Select UI adjustment
[/list]
[*][b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Menu navigation with controller and keyboard in level selection, accomplishments and options menus has been improved
[*]Level Select menu properly highlights previously selected level
[*]Charmed enemies that have been aggro'd, no longer keep their aggro on the player
[*]Cleaned up Skeleton sprites
[*]Various trinket fixes
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]MCE Version 0.80.1 - October 5th, 2016[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where OpenGL version (MAC & Linux) was releasing Render Textures that were still in use, when changing resolution or fullscreen mode.
[*]Fixed an issue where the game would change resolution on launch every time, causing screen to blink black at start.
[*]Several minor Trinket effects were fixed.
[*]Disabled controller rumble in Main Menu.
[/list]
[/list]
